mentl/914d14f:
The cross-frequency-coupling pipeline (lib/dsp/cfc.mn + the demo) sheds its
scaled-Int fixed-point carrier — the 2026-07-19 workaround for a [Float] list
that did not round-trip — and runs on native f64 samples, phase/amplitude
columns, and comodulogram matrix. It still finds the planted (6,40) coupling
(frontier cfc-demo exit 42), with the scaling scaffold deleted (65 fewer WAT
lines). This validates the wide-element cash-out on the real research workload:
representation stress on real DSP, the verification leg that catches what the
m2==m3 fixpoint cannot.

That same stress surfaced the deepest open value-layer bug, now evidenced with
a minimal repro (tests/repro/mn-unannotated-float-accumulator.mn,
Hβ.value.seq-element-stride-carrier). An unannotated float accumulator threaded
through recursion leaves its type a variable when the body is checked, so the
function compiles once at the i32 floor and reads f64 arguments as words: the
sum is garbage, exit 1, zero diagnostics. A generic function over a wide element
compiled at the word floor cannot serve a Float instantiation. The ultimate fix
is monomorphization or a runtime stride carrier; the honest intermediate (broken
-> diagnostic, never silent) is a refusal where a wide-repr argument meets a
word-repr parameter of a generic body. CFC dodges it by annotating every float
accumulator; the annotated path is broad and green, verified by an 8-case
representation-stress battery.

No boot re-pin: cfc.mn is a leaf the compiler compiles but never calls, so
m2 == m3 holds directly. Census 0.

mentl/91eb654:
Four cuts, one dig, each pinned in the artifact before its byte changed:

The call-edge row read chased the call's fresh row var alone; open-open
unification can leave that var FREE with the callee's inline names on
the far side of the union edge (the recursive-callee case), so the
free-arm added a bare var and the caller's row accumulated EMPTY —
every call INTO such a caller went bare and the strict scan met an
empty region. The read now takes the callee's own row expression,
names and tail, from the callee node's bound TFun; the var-chase stays
as the effect-polymorphic-param fallback.

row_without_self: a recursive fn's row equation R = names ∪ R binds its
least solution — a var-tail landing on the fn's own row handle cuts to
the closed names at exit, so no row ever contains its own handle.

LSuspend's transient parks in a per-site sst_{h} local (the variant_{h}
precedent): the shared $state_tmp died across emit_expr_list(args) — an
LMakeClosure argument clobbered it and the dispatch call_indirect'ed
the argument's fn index with the callee's arity.

string_offset_lookup's target pinned String: both compare operands were
tuple-destructure binders, the seed emitted pointer-eq, and a
content-equal COPY of a registered string (an instantiated row's ename,
a perform's key) missed the intern table and keyed evidence regions 0.

march-gate: 8 pass / 0 fail — first all-green board. t-plain=9,
t-rec=9, hof-map=6. Micros hold 28/34; the six residues are unrelated
named faces. Ratchet holds 0.

mentl/91ea870:
Closes Stage 4a of the cargo-class multi-core cascade. The import IS
the bridge; no wrapper function. Substrate:

1. src/lower.mn: new LowExpr variant `LWasiCall(Int, String, List)`
   — handle, import name (no $ prefix), args. Recognized at PerformExpr
   lower-time when op_name matches is_wasi_import_op.

2. src/lower.mn: is_wasi_import_op predicate — recognizes wasi_thread_
   spawn, wasi_num_cores, fd_write, fd_read, fd_close, path_open,
   path_create_directory, path_filestat_get, path_unlink_file,
   path_rename, fd_readdir, proc_exit, atomic_load_i32,
   atomic_store_i32, atomic_rmw, wait_i32, notify, fence — all WASI
   preview1 + atomics + threads imports.

3. src/lower.mn: PerformExpr lower-arm dispatches via is_wasi_import_op
   — WASI names produce LWasiCall, others stay as LPerform.

4. src/lower.mn: lexpr_handle accessor extended for LWasiCall.

5. src/backends/wasm.mn: LWasiCall arms added to
     - collect_strings_expr (string-literal pre-pass)
     - collect_slots_expr (state-slot pre-pass)
     - collect_fn_names_expr (fn-name pre-pass)
     - max_arity_expr (type-section sizing)
     - collect_fn_emit_records_expr (per-fn parallel emit walk)
     - emit_let_locals_expr (locals declaration walk)
     - emit_expr — the LOAD-BEARING arm: emits direct
       `(call $<import_name> args)` with NO __state push and NO $op_
       prefix.

mentl2 still validates on trivial input. The bridge IS the surface:
`perform wasi_thread_spawn(closure_ptr)` in wheel-source now lowers
to `(call $wasi_thread_spawn ...)` in WAT — bypassing the handler-arm
dispatch entirely. Post-L1, mentl3 ships with WASI threads activated

Stage 4b (atomic CAS perm_alloc / per-closure arena) is the remaining
peer for elimination of heap contention. The bridge is in place; the
arena is the remaining substrate refinement.

two-top/9140e3a:
- render::cull_excess_effects enforces EFFECT_SPRITE_CAP = 500 on live
  cosmetic particles. A Fire-trail + Multishot slugfest can spray hundreds of
  bursts/sec; the cap bounds the entity count and the per-frame
  advance_effect_sprites walk. Free under the cap (one count, no alloc); only
  over it does it collect + sort, dropping the most-finished sprites first
  (nearest to auto-despawn → least visible; effectively oldest-first since
  progress rises with age). select_effect_culls is unit-tested.
- app::frame_time_watch emits an info!-level two_top::perf summary every 5 s
  (frames / avg ms / max ms / count over the 16.67 ms 60-fps budget), info! so
  it survives the release log filter — the lens for the operator's profiling
  session.
- BUILD_PLAN Phase 18 notes document both, and flag the 5-minute desktop
  profiling + on-device 60-fps verification as operator-batched (M6).
